add: A collection can be created from three screens and removed from none — the rows are plain navigation and deleteCollection (CollectionManager.ts:154) has no UI caller. No CMS surface checks role: a VIEWER can create, publish and delete, and the refusal arrives as a sync-failure toast.

One binding serves one record. No repeater, no collection-bound list and no “Repeat with collection” control exists in this file or the product — RepeaterRenderer.ts and bindCollection (CMSBindingManager.ts:215) have no UI caller. No search, no filter, no paging.
why: UX-C-06 (Critical), UX-C-23 (Minor), UX-C-29 (Minor), FIG-A-01 (absence recorded, not drawn)

add: Published governs dynamic pages, not bindings: export resolves with no status filter (CMSBindingManager.ts:120-123), so a draft's copy ships. Flipping the switch refreshes nothing on canvas; deleting a record blanks every element bound to it, uncounted. And on a real site the binding does not survive a reload — sites.ts:192-214 strips cmsBindings in transit.
Fields can be added and deleted and nothing else: updateField and reorderFields (CollectionManager.ts:201,232) have no UI caller, so a mistyped field name is permanent unless the field is destroyed.

Sources live in an in-memory Map (DataManager.ts:47); ProjectData has no field for them, so every source is gone on reload and everything built on it stops resolving silently. A duplicate top-level key throws and is reported as “Not valid JSON”.

The store key is built from the project NAME in this browser (useContentPanel.ts:81, contentPanelUtils.ts:21-23), so renaming the site orphans every variable at once and two sites sharing a name share theirs.

A condition's only effect is a data-condition-hidden attribute nothing reads (DataManager.ts:482-491), evaluated once at creation — the element stays visible on canvas and on the published site. Pick mode arms with no notice and no Cancel until after a pick.

The type a field was given does not decide the input it gets: an Image field is a plain text box in both record editors, with no route to the media library (useContentModals.ts:89 exists; neither imports it), and date and select are free text here and real widgets in the ⌘⇧P modal.
